propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 800-line boundary due to mixed concerns: file loading, unknown-field preservation, tempfile cleanup, JSON encoding, rotation ordering, and alert persistence, risking silent data loss during refactoring

Extract a private BindingRepository unit-of-work that preserves byte-for-byte load/save contracts, exception semantics, and rotation-before-live ordering while maintaining unchanged public BindingStore facade
Repository must support legacy fixture loading with unknown fields, round-trip byte equality, and no eager rewrites; failures inject tempfile/rotation/retired/live/alert faults with oracle validation
Preserve rotation order, retired-first moves, best-effort alert writes, exact sorted/indented/newline serialization, and selective five-file publication without multi-file atomicity claims
Create binding-lifecycle ADR distinguishing repository unit-of-work durability from external tickets publication and recording exact-match recovery boundary
